text:
# Retail operations

## Requirements

- Staff must be given a rest break after six hours, under the Working Time Order.
- Customer complaints must be acknowledged within two working days, under the Consumer Services Code.

## Stories

- As a store manager, I want to see today's sales by till so that I can spot a slow hour.
- As a store manager, I want to print a shelf label so that prices are readable.
- As a store manager, I want to order stock from the depot so that shelves stay full.
- As a store manager, I want to report a damaged item so that it is removed from sale.
- As a store manager, I want to assign a cashier to a till so that queues stay short.
- As a store manager, I want to see staff holidays so that I can plan cover.
- As a store manager, I want to approve a price match so that we stay competitive.
- As a store manager, I want to send a message to all staff so that everyone hears the same thing.
- As a store manager, I want to check the safe count so that the float is right.
- As a store manager, I want to view customer feedback so that I can respond to complaints.
- As a store manager, I want to book a delivery slot so that the lorry can unload.
- As a store manager, I want to see the promotions calendar so that I can set up displays.
- As a store manager, I want to scan a returned item so that stock is corrected.
- As a store manager, I want to check a gift card balance so that I can answer a customer.
- As a store manager, I want to record a spillage so that the area is made safe.
- As a store manager, I want to view footfall by hour so that I can schedule staff.
- As a store manager, I want to transfer stock to another shop so that a customer gets what they want.
- As a store manager, I want to see the weekly rota so that I know who is in.
- As a store manager, I want to mark an item as out of stock so that the website is accurate.
- As a store manager, I want to review the opening checklist so that nothing is missed.
- As a store manager, I want to print a till receipt copy so that a customer can claim a refund.
- As a store manager, I want to see supplier delivery times so that I can plan receiving.
- As a store manager, I want to report a broken fridge so that engineers are alerted.
- As a store manager, I want to check loyalty points so that I can help a member.
- As a store manager, I want to view the loss prevention report so that I can act on shrinkage.
- As a store manager, I want to schedule a stock take so that counts are on time.
- As a cashier, I want a reminder to take a rest break after six hours on the till so that I am never kept working without one.
- As a store manager, I want to record a temperature check so that chilled food is safe.
- As a store manager, I want to log a refund with a reason so that returns are traceable.
- As a store manager, I want to see which tills are open so that I can balance the floor.
- As a store manager, I want to approve overtime so that busy days are covered.
